EXHIBITION OF "THIRD LIGHT"

The National Ballroom (国际舞厅) publishes
the following advertisement in the "Sin Wan Pao" :-
Recently Professor Alexander ( 亚歷山大打 )
of Belgium invented an electric light that can penetrate
human bodies. As there is no suitable name for such a
light, it has been simply named as "third light". The
Professor, at the earnest request of the management of this
ballroom, has promised to conduct practical experiments
of the light from 6 p.m. to-day. Visitors are requested
to come early as a full audience is certain.
Such a gigantic offering can be made only
by the National Ballroom.
Acting on instructions, persons under 16
years of age will not be allowed admittance. Female
visitors will not be admitted.
For the experiment, this ballroom recently
examined many Chinese and foreign women, but none of the
applicants were found suitable because of high age or poor
physique. It is gratifying to report that Miss Anna
( 安娜 ), a young girl, is ready to make sacrifices for
the sake of science. To her we express our thanks.

比利时亚历山大教授（Professor Alexander (亚历山大)）最近发明了一种能穿透人体的电灯。由于此种光线尚无合适名称，故暂命名为“第三光”。应本舞厅管理层之恳请，该教授承诺自今日下午六时起进行光线实际实验。鉴于观众必然爆满，敬请访客尽早光临。
如此盛大之举，唯国际舞厅方能呈现。
奉命行事，十六岁以下人士不准入场。女性访客恕不接待。
为进行实验，本舞厅近期检查了许多中外女性，但申请者皆因年龄过大或体质欠佳而不适合。令人欣慰的是，年轻女子安娜小姐（Miss Anna (安娜)）愿为科学做出牺牲。特此向她致谢。

"The Great Peach River" - Staged by nude Chinese

"Betty Carmen," "Ya-Tan-Ni," "Nora" and "Havilan,"
the four mysterious girls of Paris and members of the Troupe,
have come to Shanghai for the first time. At one time
they staged secret performances at the Midnight Club in
Paris and the admission was charged at 10 francs. This
shows the mysterious nature of the performances.

Programmes

1. Open air bath in a summer night.
2. I want to do it.
3. A dull spring.
4. A sacred body.
5. Four lively horses.
6. The breasts of a virgin.
7. A peach-coloured underwear.
8. The hole of a strange door.
9. The night life of Paris.
10. Her belt.
11. Let's undress ourselves.

Programmes are changed on Sundays.

Five shows a day: 2 p.m., 3.30 p.m., 5 p.m.
7.30 p.m. and 9 p.m.

This theatre is adjacent to the Settlement and is
safe and non-obstructive to patrons.

Chung Kuo Jin Pao (中国日报), a mosquito newspaper,
publishes the following article on February 22,1934.

--------

Ah Hwa (a girl) put one leg on a bench in the
hot water shop and joked with Ah Wu(a man). The longer
Ah Wu looked at her leg on the bench, the harder did it
become for him to restrain himself. He stretched out one
of his hands and groped from Ah Hwa's knee upward.
Ah Hwa was used to his groping and paid no heed.
But Ah Wu became audacious and with his finger tip, he
slightly touched her 'itchy' part. As she had never tasted
of the 'flavour' before, she felt so flurried that she
hurriedly retreated, tipping the bucket of hot water which
she was carrying and wetting her trousers.
Fortunately, the water was not very hot. Her
'itchy' part,however, was enlarged and she felt pain
there.
But Ah Wu tittered. He raised his finger and
whispered in her ear, 'Do you not think it strange that
before your trousers got wet, my finger had already been
moistened?' After he said the sentence, he raised the
finger to his nose and smelled it.
Ah Hwa was prone to compromise, but under the
circumstances she blushed and scolded Ah Wu for his
escapade.
pages.zh:
编辑：黄禅陶（Huang Chan Tao (黄禅陶)）
地址：西藏路大顺里10号（No.10 Dah Shun Li Aileyway(大顺里), Thibet Road.）。
《中国日报》（Chung Kuo Jin Pao (中国日报)），一家小报，于1934年2月22日刊登如下文章。

--------

阿花（一名女子）在热水店将一条腿搁在长凳上，与阿武（一名男子）调笑。阿武盯着她在长凳上的腿看得越久，就越难克制自己。他伸出一只手，从阿花的膝盖向上摸索。阿花习惯了他的摸索，并未在意。但阿武变得大胆起来，用指尖轻轻触碰了她的“痒处”。由于她此前从未尝过此“滋味”，感到惊慌失措，急忙后退，打翻了手中提着的热水桶，弄湿了裤子。
幸而水温不高。然而，她的“痒处”肿胀起来，并感到疼痛。
但阿武窃笑。他抬起手指，在她耳边低语：“你不觉得奇怪吗？在你裤子湿之前，我的手指已经湿润了？”说完这句话，他将手指凑到鼻子前闻了闻。
阿花倾向于妥协，但在这种情况下，她脸红并斥责阿武的轻浮行为。

pages.en:
-2-

At this time, many loafers who were drinking
tea in the hot water shop came out and joked with
Ah Hwa and crouched down and peeped at her dew wetted
'Peony'. Ah San (one of the loafers) said to the
crowd 'To-day we have seen something at a much
cheaper price than that we paid for seeing foreign
girls at the 'Flowery World'.
pages.zh:
-2-

此时，许多在热水店喝茶的闲汉走出来，与阿花开玩笑，并蹲下偷看她被露水（原文如此，结合上下文应为热水）打湿的“牡丹”。阿三（闲汉之一）对人群说：“今天我们看到的东西，比我们在‘大世界’看外国姑娘所花的价钱便宜多了。”

A GLIMPSE OF PARIS (2)

The prostitutes in Paris are registered by
the Government for business. These are many classes of
prostitutes. The best class prostitutes are of different
nationalities. The arrangements and furnitures in the
rooms of these prostitutes adopt the styles of their
respective countries. Moreover, there are various forms
and gestures during the act. There are lewd dens in
which prostitutes wear nothing but a pair of slippers.
Patrons of these dens, when entering the front doors, are
surrounded by these naked prostitutes. They make and
perform every kind of awkward movements in order to induce
one to make a selection. They have a kind of strange skill;
that is, if for two francs, they will let you see them
smoking cigarettes with their vaginas; or if you place a
copper coin on the edge of a table, it can be sucked into
the secret hole. Public prostitutes are to be found in
dancing halls, parks, and on the roads. In Paris, you
never worry how to find a woman. What you worry about is
how to evade women.
